contents.text: This is the first of four things the agent does. A guest wants a sea view and is bringing a dog. Only the garden room takes dogs, so the agent opens that room, not the one they asked about.

choices.label: It shows the booking as a card
choices.why: The second of the four, the request as a clear card.

choices.label: Explain another section
choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name.

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick this up another time.
